description: This file implements a watchdog timer driver for Nordic Semiconductor's nRF series chips using the nrfx library within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes setup, disable, timeout installation, and feed functions, as well as device initialization and interrupt handling for multiple watchdog instances.

methods.name: wdt_nrf_setup
methods.description: Configures and starts the watchdog timer with specified options.

methods.name: wdt_nrf_disable
methods.description: Stops the watchdog timer if supported.

methods.name: wdt_nrf_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a timeout configuration for the watchdog channel.

methods.name: wdt_nrf_feed
methods.description: Feeds (refreshes) the watchdog to prevent timeout.
